INSERT INTO knowledge_chunk( document_id, document_version, chunk_index, content, token_count, vector_id, embedding_model, embedding_version, status ) VALUES
( #{chunk.documentId}, #{chunk.documentVersion}, #{chunk.chunkIndex}, #{chunk.content}, #{chunk.tokenCount}, #{chunk.vectorId}, #{chunk.embeddingModel}, #{chunk.embeddingVersion}, #{chunk.status} )
mapper.select:
SELECT kc. id AS chunkId, kc.document_id AS documentId, kc.document_version AS documentVersion, kc.chunk_index AS chunkIndex, kc.vector_id AS vectorId, kc. content AS content,
kd.title AS title, kd. category AS category, kd.source AS source
FROM knowledge_chunk kc
INNER JOIN knowledge_document kd ON kd.id = kc.document_id
WHERE kc.vector_id IN
#{vectorId}
AND kc.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND kd.processing_status = 'READY'
AND kc.document_version = kd.document_version
AND kc.embedding_model = #{embeddingModel}
AND kc.embedding_version = #{embeddingVersion}
